Iris (CS): hey team — i'm Iris, starting coverage on Noah's EMEA accounts today. need HubSpot support seat, Dialpad softphone + EU number, Gong listen, and the short CS starter playbook. fastest path? cc @Noah
Noah (Sales): welcome Iris! :wave: i'll DM the account roster and priority tags. ping Priya for seats. quick note: mark timezone=CEST in the ticket for EU numbers.
Iris (CS): thanks — also ran into an SSO hiccup during onboarding training, do CS folks get immediate SSO or is it after ticket approval?
Priya (IT): hi Iris — SSO is provisioned when the HubSpot seat is added; sometimes MFA enrollment prompts delay access. if you hit an SSO loop include `mfa-reset=true` in the ticket. fastest command:
```
/seat-request product=hubspot role=support_user user=iris@redwood.ai region=eu reason="CS EMEA handoff" mfa-reset=true
```
and for Dialpad:
```
/seat-request product=dialpad seat=softphone user=iris@redwood.ai request_number=true region=eu timezone=CEST hardware=true
```
Add `gong_listen=true folders="EMEA Demos"` if you want recordings.
Iris (CS): perfect — i'll include MFA reset in the ticket. can someone point me to the condensed CS starter playbook? want the 1-page checklist.
Dana (Ops): quick link: https://drive.redwood.ai/CS/starter-one-pager.pdf — covers intro email, 24h checkpoints, and escalation contacts. we also keep a small collateral bundle (slide deck + integration one-pager) in the same folder.
Noah (Sales): i'll attach two demo clips and the recommended sequence IDs in the DM. Pro tip: copy the "EMEA - Post Demo" sequence to your Gong library and change the times for CEST.
Iris (CS): thanks. one more thing — will I be added to onboarding@redwood.ai shared inbox or do CS agents handle replies individually?
Liam (CS Lead): onboarding@redwood.ai is owned by CS Ops; you'll be added after seats are live. we'll also add you to the EMEA rotation and the escalation Slack channel #cs-emea-escalations.
Iris (CS): awesome. last Q: hardware shipping to EU addresses — any customs notes?
Dana (Ops): we ship small headsets DDP for EU addresses; include `hardware=true shipping_address="<address>" customs_info_included=true` in the ticket and Ops will confirm. typical turnaround 48-72 hours.
onboarding-bot: Ticket #5012 created for Iris: HubSpot (support_user + mfa-reset), Dialpad (softphone + EU number + hardware), Gong Listen (folders: EMEA Demos). ETA: 1 business day.
helpdesk-bot: Note: If SSO fails after provisioning, open a Helpdesk incident and tag Priya.
Iris (CS): thanks all — i'll wait for provisioning and then book a 30-min sync with Noah to run the top 5 EMEA accounts. i'm free 09:00-11:00 CEST tomorrow.
Noah (Sales): 10:00 CEST works, invite sent. i'll bring the account background and two demo snippets.
Liam (CS Lead): i'll join the sync to walk the playbook and the escalation matrix. welcome aboard! :tada:
